# Shot-boundary regression source

`build.py` is retained solely because `tests/test_product_launch.py` executes
its 21 shot specifications and checks a carried workflow and inbox pose across
cuts. It is the historical fictional 95-second Ruang demo, not an approved
SaaS design, a Numtera reconstruction, or a recommended film to publish.

The tests generate temporary assets and frames. Do not promote this builder
back into a creative example because its validation passes.
